_comment: Local cache of already-known Feynman integrals, keyed by Nickel index.
'result' should hold a closed form only when it is actually known;
otherwise leave it empty and give a 'reference' so the agent reports a
pointer rather than inventing an expression.
A Nickel index names a graph, not an integral, so an entry for a massive
one needs 'masses': one term per propagator in this entry's own Nickel
order, empty string for a massless line. Omit it and every line is taken
as massless, which is what all three entries below are.

integrals.name: massless one-loop bubble
integrals.result: G(nu1,nu2) = Gamma(nu1+nu2-d/2) Gamma(d/2-nu1) Gamma(d/2-nu2) / (Gamma(nu1) Gamma(nu2) Gamma(d-nu1-nu2)) * (-p^2)^(d/2-nu1-nu2)   [normalisation: int d^d l/(i pi^(d/2)), propagators (-l^2)^nu1 (-(l+p)^2)^nu2]
integrals.reference: textbook; e.g. Smirnov, 'Analytic Tools for Feynman Integrals', eq. (A.1)
integrals.notes: Single master. Exact in d; expand with d = 4 - 2 eps.

integrals.name: one-loop triangle, one off-shell leg
integrals.notes: Reduces to the massless bubble; the one-mass triangle is not an independent master.

integrals.name: massless planar double box
integrals.reference: hep-ph/9905323 (Smirnov, analytic result for the on-shell massless double box)
integrals.notes: 8 masters for the massless off-shell family, as reproduced by the NeatIBP run shipped with this repo (examples/dbox).
